account_language_help: The app and emails from Kotivalo are in this language. Your choice is saved at once.
account_name_help: Your name is shown to the people you share flats with.

amounts_footnote: The year summary works out rent and charges month by month from these amounts. A change applies from the date you choose, and old amounts are never overwritten.
amounts_form_hint_charge: The year summary counts the charge month by month from the start date.
amounts_form_hint_first: The start date is usually when the lease or the ownership began. Amounts always change from the start of a month.
amounts_form_hint_rent: Check the lease for when and how the rent may be raised.
amounts_member_note: Only owners can change the amounts.
amounts_treatment_capitalised_note: added to the acquisition cost, not deducted from rental income
amounts_treatment_capitalised_text: The charge is placed in reserve by the housing company. It isn't deducted but added to the flat's acquisition cost, which counts when the flat is sold.
amounts_treatment_form_hint: Usually the start of the housing company's financial year. The treatment always changes from the start of a month.
amounts_treatment_form_intro: How does the housing company book the financing charge? The property manager knows, and it is often in the financial statements too.
amounts_treatment_income_recognised_text: The housing company books the charge as revenue. It is deducted from rental income like the maintenance charge.
amounts_treatment_not_set_note: The property manager knows whether the charge is recorded as revenue or placed in reserve.
amounts_treatment_undo_only_text: The treatment is removed. You can set it again from the right date.
amounts_treatment_undo_text: The previous treatment, “{treatment}” from {date}, applies again.
amounts_undo_only_text: The amount is removed. You can set it again from the right date.
amounts_undo_text: The previous amount, {amount} from {date}, applies again.
app_tagline: Light for a landlord's everyday work
email_action_fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this address into your browser:
invitation_email_ignore: If you don't know the sender, you can ignore this email. The flat isn't shown to you unless you accept the invitation.
invitation_email_intro: {inviter} ({inviterEmail}) shared a flat with you in Kotivalo, the app for landlords.
invitation_email_sign_in: Sign in with {email} to see and accept the invitation.
invitation_email_subject: You're invited to a flat in Kotivalo
invitation_email_validity: The invitation is valid for {days} days.
not_found_text: There is no page at this address. Check the address or go back to the home page.
offline_body: Kotivalo needs a network connection. Check your connection and try again.
ownership_correct_hint: The date must be before the next ownership change ({date}).
ownership_history_footer: The year summary splits income and expenses by the shares of each period, so a change mid-year is calculated correctly for everyone.
ownership_member_note: Only owners can invite people, remove access and change ownership.
ownership_owner_note: A member sees the flat and can edit its details. Owners can invite people, remove access and change ownership.
ownership_preview_correction: The date is the current period's start, so this corrects its split; no new period is added.
ownership_preview_hint: A share above 0% makes the person an owner, 0% a member.
ownership_remove_access_hint: If you don't, they stay a member and still see the flat.
ownership_total_wrong: The shares add up to {total}. They must add up to 100%.
ownership_undo_text: The ownership goes back to {split} from {date}. If the change removed someone's access, it isn't restored.
properties_empty_text: Kotivalo keeps a flat's rent, costs and tax figures in one place. Start with the flat's address and size.
property_owned_since_hint: The day the flat became yours. You own 100% of it to start with. Co-owners are invited and the shares are split on the flat's Ownership and sharing page.
reason_amount_changed: Someone changed the amounts or the treatment at the same time. Reload the page and try again.
reason_amount_date_before_ownership: The date can't be before the month the flat's ownership began.
reason_amount_date_not_month_start: Amounts change from the start of a month. Choose the first day of a month, for example 01/01/2027.
reason_amount_date_too_early: The date can't be before the latest change.
reason_amount_invalid: Enter the amount in euros, for example 214 or 214.50.
reason_amount_nothing_to_undo: This amount isn't set, so there is nothing to undo. Reload the page.
reason_code_attempts_used: Ask for a new code and try again.
reason_code_expired: Ask for a new code below.
reason_code_wrong: That code is wrong. Check it and try again.
reason_date_invalid: Enter the date as dd/mm/yyyy, for example 12/06/2022.
reason_email_failed: The code couldn't be sent. Try again.
reason_email_invalid: Check the email address, for example name@example.com.
reason_email_quota: Today's sending limit is used up. Try again tomorrow.
reason_email_quota_title: Codes can't be sent right now
reason_floor_area_invalid: Enter the floor area in square metres, for example 48.5.
reason_invitation_already_member: This address already has access to the flat.
reason_invitation_already_pending: An invitation has already been sent to this address. Cancel it first to send a new one.
reason_invitation_daily_limit_reached: You can send 20 invitations a day. Try again later.
reason_invitation_email_failed: The invitation couldn't be sent. Try again.
reason_invitation_email_quota: Today's sending limit is used up. Try again tomorrow.
reason_invitation_email_quota_title: Invitations can't be sent right now
reason_invitation_limit_reached: A flat can have 10 open invitations. Cancel one or wait for replies.
reason_invitation_not_found: The owner may have cancelled it, or it has expired. Ask for a new invitation.
reason_invitation_not_found_title: The invitation is no longer valid
reason_limit_reached: Wait a moment and then try again.
reason_name_invalid: A name can't contain a web address, line breaks or the characters @ / : < >.
reason_name_too_long: The name is too long. Use at most 50 characters.
reason_network: Check your network connection and try again.
reason_ownership_date_in_future: The date can't be in the future.
reason_ownership_date_too_early: The change can't start before the current ownership period does.
reason_ownership_date_too_late: The date must be before the next ownership change.
reason_ownership_invalid: The split can only include people with access to the flat, each once. Reload the page and try again.
reason_ownership_invalid_title: The ownership split can't be saved
reason_ownership_no_owner: At least one person must have a share.
reason_ownership_nothing_to_undo: The flat has only its first ownership period. Correct its start date if needed.
reason_ownership_share_invalid: Enter the share as a percentage, for example 50 or 33.33.
reason_ownership_shares_total: The shares must add up to 100%.
reason_property_limit_reached: You can add at most 100 flats to Kotivalo.
reason_property_not_found: It may have been removed, or you don't have access to it.
reason_receipt_too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB. Take a photo of the receipt or make the PDF smaller.
reason_receipt_unreadable: The image couldn't be processed. Try another image or take a new one.
reason_receipt_unsupported_type: The receipt must be an image (JPEG, PNG or WebP) or a PDF.
reason_sharing_owner_only: Inviting people and removing access are up to the flat's owner.
reason_sharing_owner_only_title: Only the owner can do this
reason_storage_quota_full: You can store up to 500 MB or 1,000 receipt files, and this one doesn't fit. Save the entry without a receipt, or delete old receipts.
reason_text_too_long: The text is too long. Use at most 100 characters.
reason_transaction_amount_invalid: Enter the amount in euros, for example 145 or 145.50. It must be between €0.01 and €99,999.99.
reason_transaction_date_before_ownership: The date can't be before the flat's ownership began.
reason_transaction_date_in_future: The date can't be in the future.
reason_transaction_not_found: The entry may have been deleted. Go back to the entries and reload the page.
reason_transaction_note_too_long: The description is too long. Use at most 200 characters.
reason_treatment_nothing_to_undo: The treatment isn't set, so there is nothing to undo. Reload the page.
sharing_invite_hint: The invited person sees only this flat. They sign in to Kotivalo with this address and accept the invitation.
sharing_leave_dialog_text: {address} will disappear from your list. You can only get access back if the owner invites you again.
sharing_remove_dialog_text: {name} will no longer see {address}. Access can only be given back with a new invitation.
sign_in_code_validity: The code is valid for {minutes} minutes.
sign_in_email_ignore: If you didn't ask for a code, you can ignore this email. No one can get into your account without the code.
sign_in_email_intro: Sign in to Kotivalo by entering this code in the app:
sign_in_email_validity: The code is valid for {minutes} minutes.
sign_in_intro: We'll email you a sign-in code. No password needed.
sign_in_new_account: A new address gets a new account.
sign_in_resend_wait: You can ask for a new code in {time}.
sign_in_spam_hint: Didn't get a code? Check your spam folder.
transactions_category_water_charge: Water charges to the housing company
transactions_computed_note: Rent and charges are calculated from the amounts you set, so you don't log them.
transactions_empty_text: Log income and expenses, such as repairs and insurance, and attach the receipt. Entries appear in the year summary.
transactions_member_note: Only the owners can add and edit entries. You can open and download the receipts.
welcome_hint: Your name is shown to the people you share flats with. Your first name is enough.
